Name: Kunkun Video Player
Author: Dingtrue114
Description:
Description 
Kunkun Video Player is a highly customizable, i18n-supported media player mod for Stardew Valley 1.6. It allows you to watch your favorite local videos seamlessly in-game without leaving your farm or pausing your work.This mod is inspired by aedenthorn's Video Player mod.
Please note that my programming skills are very limited, and a significant portion of this mod was generated with the help of AI. As a result, the mod might still feel a bit rough around the edges. I truly appreciate your understanding and patience! 
Installation instructions
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Install Generic Mod Config Menu (Highly Recommended).[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Place the video files you want to watch (.mp4, .mkv, .avi, or .mov) into the Mods/Kunkun Video Player/assets/Videos folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game![/*]
[/list]Main features
[list]
[*]In-Game Local Playback: Supports mainstream formats like .mp4, .mkv, .avi, and .mov inside the game.[/*]
[*]Play While Working: Watch videos while fishing, mining, or farming. Enabling background activity ensures the game won't automatically pause when the player is open.[/*]
[*]Smart Floating UI & Immersive Mode: Features a draggable floating icon and resizable video box. Switch to Immersive Mode instantly to hide all control buttons for clean full-screen viewing.[/*]
[*]Automatic Progress Tracking: Seamlessly remembers and saves the playback progress for each local video, allowing you to resume exactly where you left off.[/*]
[*]Flexible GMCM Customization: Fully compatible with the Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM). You can customize hotkeys, UI coordinates, colors, the TV channel name (defaults to More Programs), and even a custom clickable redirect link at the bottom of the menu.[/*]
[/list]Requirements
[list]
[*]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API (Required)[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (Highly Recommended for customizing hotkeys, UI, channel names, and links in-game)[/*]
[/list]A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4404]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4404[/url]

模组简介
坤坤视频播放器是一款专为《星露谷物语》1.6 版本打造的独立视频播放器模组。它拥有完善的中英双语本地化支持，让您无需切出游戏，即可在种田时惬意观影！本模组灵感源自 aedenthorn 制作的 Video Player 模组。
另外想提前说明的是，由于本人的编程水平非常有限，代码中的很多内容都是借助 AI 协助生成的，所以模组目前可能显得比较粗糙，难免会有不完美的地方，希望大家能够理解！
安装说明
[list=1]
[*]安装最新版本的 SMAPI。[/*]
[*]安装 Generic Mod Config Menu (通用模组配置菜单，强烈推荐)。[/*]
[*]下载本模组，并将其解压到你的 Stardew Valley/Mods 文件夹中。[/*]
[*]将你想看的视频文件（.mp4、.mkv、.avi 或 .mov 格式）直接放入 Mods/Kunkun Video Player/assets/Videos 文件夹内。[/*]
[*]启动游戏即可！[/*]
[/list]核心特色
[list]
[*]本地高效播放：支持 .mp4、.mkv、.avi 和 .mov 等主流视频格式，在游戏内直接读取并播放。[/*]
[*]边干活边追剧：钓鱼、挖矿、务农时也能同步看视频，开启后台交互可确保游戏在播放视频时不自动暂停，干活娱乐两不误。[/*]
[*]悬浮UI与沉浸模式：拥有可鼠标拖拽的屏幕悬浮图标，视频窗口大小可自由缩放。开启沉浸模式可一键隐藏控制栏，享受纯净全屏观影。[/*]
[*]自动断点续播：模组会自动记忆每个视频的播放进度，下次打开直接接着看，省去手动拉进度条的麻烦。[/*]
[*]电视注入与自由定制：除了快捷键和悬浮窗，模组还无痕注入了电视机，早晨与电视互动即可唤出播放器。完全兼容通用模组配置菜单（GMCM），可在游戏内随时修改快捷键、颜色、UI坐标、自定义电视频道名（默认“更多节目”）及底部的跳转链接。[/*]
[/list]前置需求
[list]
[*]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API (必备前置)[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (强烈推荐前置，用于在游戏内修改快捷键、界面UI、电视频道名和跳转链接[/*]
[/list]我的星露谷物语全部模组清单可在此链接查看：[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4404]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4404[/url]
